question_text: Why did the children go to Yasmin Khala's house?
answer_text: Children went to Yasmin Khala's house to know about the person who is responsible for the maintenance of the street lights and to whom they should pay. So, they went to Yasmin Khala's house as she recently retired from the Municipal Corporation and could tell them about it.

question_text: List four ways in which the work of the Municipal Corporation affects the life of a city-dweller.
answer_text: Four ways in which the work of the Municipal Corporation affects the life of a city-dweller are: (i) Construction and maintenance of roads, parks, street lights etc. (ii) Cleansing and maintenance of drainage system. (iii) Collection and disposal of garbage. (iv) Supply of safe drinking water.
final_answer: These services are essential for the well-being of city residents.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of municipal functions and their impact.

question_text: What did Gangabai do and why?
answer_text: Gangabai went to the Ward Councillor house after gathering small group of women shouting slogans and described the situation in the locality to him. She did so because there were uncollected garbage lying all over in the locality which attracts dogs, rats and flies and people are getting ill from this.
final_answer: Her actions were aimed at addressing the sanitation issues in her locality.

question_text: How does the Municipal Corporation earn the money to do its work?
answer_text: Municipal Corporation earns money from the taxes collected from various sources like the property taxes, water taxes, entertainment taxes and also from taxes on education and other amenities.
final_answer: These taxes are essential for funding municipal services.

subject: civics
question_text: Why do you think it is important that the Corporation should spend more money on slum localities?
answer_text: It is important that the Corporation should spend more money on slum localities because: (i) If they do not provide them equal facilities then it is discrimination on the basis of economic condition. (ii) Slums are also a part of the society. The people living there contribute a lot for the society and also the major work population like domestic servants Municipal workers, cleaners etc.
final_answer: Equitable spending ensures social justice and public health.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of social equity and municipal responsibilities.
